metadata.purpose: Designed to support Sarbanes-Oxley §404 internal-controls evidentiary patterns and FINRA Rule 3110 supervision-record requirements. Not a compliance attestation. Verdifax provides the policy mechanism; the customer's compliance officer attests compliance for their use case.
metadata.intended_audience: Broker-dealers, investment advisers, and public companies subject to SOX/FINRA evidentiary requirements when using AI-mediated decision systems.
metadata.what_this_does: Refuses admission when the caller fails to declare actor identity, supervisory authorization, model provenance, or decision classification. Produces a sealed AttestationGapReceipt naming the gap.
metadata.what_this_does_not_do: This profile is NOT a SOX or FINRA compliance certification. Compliance with either framework requires documented internal-control testing, signed CEO/CFO attestations, books-and-records preservation, and other process controls outside Verdifax's scope.
